page.layout: One page of index in two columns, under a running head at the top; each column read top to bottom, left column first. Letters Q, R, S, Y appear as alphabetical markers within the columns. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Ponti accolæ 97.98.99, & deinceps. | Roma, & illius descriptio 67. 68, & deinceps.
Pontus Euxinus dictus Axenus 98 | Romulus Romam condidit 67
Pyrenæi montes, eorumque descriptio 13.14 | Sabaria fons 43
Rhodanus fluit è lacu Lemā- | Sapis fl. 41

page.notes: Several numbers are faint or blurred by show-through and may be misread, notably the page references in the right column near Pylene, Sabini and Samos. The first line of the right column ends with "no" which is the tail of a longer entry. The word "Pythoη" contains a Greek-looking eta that is likely a printing error for "Python".
